diagnosis: The supplied simulate_reduced.m helper treats duration_hours as TNF-on duration. For the frozen 30 h B/C calls, TNF begins at 1 h and pulse_end becomes 31 h while the helper retains t_end=24 h. It therefore appends a reverse-time rest integration from 31 h to 24 h. The resulting reverse segment becomes numerically unstable and cannot be used to adjudicate the authors' Figure 8B/C behavior claims. The helper also hardcodes plotting normalization/x-limits to 0-10 h and therefore is not a direct long-window Figure 8B/C driver.

scientific_disposition.reason: A demonstrable execution-control-flow defect precedes scientific adjudication. Under GOM it is preserved and repaired mechanically rather than converted into either a biological failure or a pass.

next_safe_action: Create a versioned Figure 8 execution contract that distinguishes observation horizon from TNF-on duration and executes tonic TNF monotonically through the paper-defined observation window, without changing model equations, Figure 8 parameter sets, solver family, or the already-frozen behavior-adjudication rules.
